title: #114 Negative Impact
prompt: Poor lifestyles have a negative impact on people's health. List some unhealthy lifestyles and discuss what government services could help?

promptSegments.text: Poor lifestyles have a negative impact on people's health.
List some unhealthy lifestyles and discuss what government services could help?

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main cause of poor health is poor eating habits and lack of exercise, as people often consume bad food and do not move enough in daily life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main cause of poor health is poor eating habits and lack of exercise, as people often consume bad food and do not move enough in daily life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The government can offer better health services, such as building parks and offering free fitness classes, to encourage people to stay active.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The government can offer better health services, such as building parks and offering free fitness classes, to encourage people to stay active.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Poor eating habits and lack of physical activity are common problems, leading to a higher risk of chronic illnesses like diabetes.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Poor eating habits and lack of physical activity are common problems, leading to a higher risk of chronic illnesses like diabetes.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The government should run public health initiatives, such as free classes on healthy cooking, to teach people how to live better.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The government should run public health initiatives, such as free classes on healthy cooking, to teach people how to live better.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay identifies sedentary habits and poor diet as the primary causes of poor health.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay identifies sedentary habits and poor diet as the primary causes of poor health.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay proposes government-led public health initiatives as a key solution.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay proposes government-led public health initiatives as a key solution.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not write off-topic generalizations; ground every point in the specific context of Lifestyle.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết chung chung ngoài đề; hãy gắn chặt từng luận điểm vào bối cảnh cụ thể của Lifestyle.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh dùng các câu văn mẫu học thuộc lòng chung chung và các ý lạc đề.
